ingredients: 2 packages active dry yeast (4½ tsp total)
directions: In a mixing bowl, combine 1½ cups flour, sugar, yeast, and all seasonings.
In a saucepan, heat milk, water, and 2 tbsp butter to 120–130°F. Add to dry ingredients and beat until moistened.
Add egg and beat on medium speed for 3 minutes.
Stir in 1/2 cup Parmesan and enough remaining flour to form a soft dough.
Knead on a floured surface until smooth and elastic, about 3–5 minutes.
Place in a greased bowl, turning once. Cover and let rest 15 minutes.
Punch dough down. Divide into 16 pieces and shape into balls.
Melt remaining butter. Dip tops in butter, then in remaining Parmesan cheese.
Place in a greased 13x9-inch pan. Cover and let rest 10 minutes.
Bake at 375°F for 20–25 minutes until golden brown. Cool on a wire rack.
